termsSummary: Unpaid reuse requires visible linked attribution; leave at least three minutes between manual requests and contact Avinor before heavy server load.
scopeNote: These are ten bounded XML Public airport snapshots with TimeFrom=1, TimeTo=144 hours, codeshare=Y and both directions. Upcoming rows are schedule listings only; they do not establish recurrence, actual operation, award seats or bookability. The source freshness cutoff is retrieval +144 hours. Existing candidate effective dates are retained separately and are not extended by this snapshot.
